verdict.rationale: Devin sessions run in cloud VMs that 'keep going after you close your laptop' (docs-13). Devin Handoff moves a task from the local CLI to a cloud session (docs-38, docs-4), and the web UI with an embedded IDE lets you follow and take over the session (docs-3). Together these imply you can start work in one place and resume it from another. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of resuming or reattaching a session from a different device or browser, cloud-to-local handoff back, and independent hands-on corroboration.
